verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a local-first iOS Git client, and its optional AI features send staged diffs to OpenAI, so where data goes is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence documents no product-level region or residency selection for any data it processes or stores. Its support for self-hosted Git servers and Files-app directories is an adjacent choice of remote or location, not data-residency control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
